source: Enhancing Power Conversion Efficiency and Open-Circuit Voltage of Perovskite Solar Cells via Charge Transport Layer Engineering
target: 通过电荷传输层工程提升钙钛矿太阳能电池的光电转换效率与开路电压

source: Perovskite solar cell (PSC) devices have progressed rapidly in the past decade.
target: 钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）器件在过去十年中发展迅速。

source: Power conversion efficiency (PCE) values for the best PSC devices now exceed 25%, while the open-circuit voltage continues to improve.
target: 最优 PSC 器件的光电转换效率（PCE）现已超过 25%，开路电压也在持续提升。

source: The perovskite solar cell architecture typically sandwiches an absorber between two selective contacts.
target: 钙钛矿太阳能电池的典型结构是将吸收层夹在两层选择性接触层之间。

source: The charge transport layer extracts carriers from the absorber and delivers them to the electrode.
target: 电荷传输层从吸收层中提取载流子并将其输送至电极。

source: A poorly designed charge transport layer causes interfacial recombination and lowers the open-circuit voltage.
target: 设计不佳的电荷传输层会引起界面复合并降低开路电压。

source: The Charge Transport Layer engineering strategy reported here uses a self-assembled monolayer.
target: 本文报道的电荷传输层工程策略采用自组装单分子层。

source: This monolayer raises the Open-Circuit Voltage by roughly 60 mV in every perovskite solar cell we tested.
target: 该单分子层使我们测试的每个钙钛矿太阳能电池的开路电压提高了约 60 mV。

source: We fabricated forty PSC devices under identical conditions.
target: 我们在相同条件下制备了四十个 PSC 器件。

source: The average power conversion efficiency rose from 21.3% to 24.1%.
target: 平均光电转换效率从 21.3% 提升至 24.1%。

source: The gain in PCE correlated strongly with the increase in open-circuit voltage.
target: PCE 的提升与开路电压的增加高度相关。

source: Every device with an optimized charge transport layer retained 95% of its initial efficiency after 500 hours.
target: 每个采用优化电荷传输层的器件在 500 小时后仍保持初始效率的 95%。

source: Control devices without the modified charge transport layer degraded twice as fast.
target: 未采用改性电荷传输层的对照器件衰减速度快了一倍。

source: Figure 1: Structure of the perovskite solar cell and the energy level alignment of the charge transport layer, with the open-circuit voltage and power conversion efficiency (PCE) of champion devices.
target: 图 1：钙钛矿电池的结构与电荷传输层的能级排列，以及冠军器件的开路电压和光电转换效率（PCE）。

source: The optimized charge transport layer simultaneously improves the open-circuit voltage, the power conversion efficiency, and the stability of the perovskite solar cell.
target: 优化的电荷传输层同时提升了钙钛矿太阳能电池的开路电压、能量转换效率和稳定性。
